visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a monochromatic, cross-hatched sketch of a large, two-story Victorian house with many windows and a chimney. The title text appears in bold white Chinese characters over the dark, textured imagery, setting a somber and mysterious tone. (2) A small, white, round animated character with large black eyes and a blue mask-like patch appears in the foreground. Behind it, a single lit candle flickers in a pitch-black room, casting a warm but dim light on the character's face as it speaks. (3) The scene shifts to a detailed illustration of a family of four—father, mother, and two young boys—smiling inside a modern car. The father is driving, and they are surrounded by luggage, indicating a move, while the background depicts a sunny day. (4) The visuals transition to a dark, tiled basement room with two long metal gurneys or surgical beds. A small elevator door is visible in the background, and the room looks sterile and eerie with high-contrast shadows and cold, white lighting. (5) A split-screen phase shows the narrator character on the left and a live-action clip from a horror film on the right. The clip depicts a dark hallway with a single window and a figure moving in the distance, creating a frightening atmosphere. (6) The final phase presents the movie title and credits in gold and white text against a black background. A release date 'September 4th' is prominently displayed, followed by studio logos and production company trademarks in the bottom corners.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo male narration begins immediately with clear articulation and an energetic tone over eerie, low-frequency ambient music. The narration flows continuously with very few pauses, creating a sense of rapid information delivery. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the narration transitions to the specific year of the event. The background music adds a subtle, rhythmic ticking sound, increasing the tension and urgent atmosphere of the storytelling. (3) A heavy percussive 'thud' occurs as the basement reveal is described. The background music shifts to a more discordant and high-tension string arrangement with frequent minor-mode clusters, emphasizing the horror elements and spectral intensity. (4) The narrator's voice becomes more hushed and dramatic, utilizing varied pitch contours to convey the mystery of the 'corpse room'. The music swells in volume with deep synthesizer bass notes and metallic echoing textures. (5) A loud, cinematic 'impact' sound effect marks the transition to the movie trailer portion. High-pitched screaming and distorted digital artifacts are introduced into the audio mix, accompanied by heavy reverb and atmospheric sound design layers. (6) The final phase features a deep, low-frequency drone that slowly fades out. The narrator concludes with a brief, authoritative statement about the release date, while a final sharp stinger sound effect punctuate the end of the master audio track.
